from ledgerly import audit
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.adjustments import refund
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError

T0 = datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
def mk(amt="100.00"): return Payment("p","i",Decimal(amt),status="captured",created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)

# idempotency: same key returns same record, no double apply
p=mk(); r1=refund(p,Decimal("40.00"),T0,idempotency_key="k1"); r2=refund(p,Decimal("40.00"),T0,idempotency_key="k1")

assert audit.events("payment_refunded")[0]["idempotency_key"]=="k1"

# full refund sets status
p=mk(); refund(p,Decimal("100.00"),T0); assert p.status=="refunded"

# approval required above 500
p=mk("600.00")
try: refund(p,Decimal("500.01"),T0); assert False
except BillingError as e: assert e.code=="approval_required"
refund(p,Decimal("500.01"),T0,approved_by="mgr"); assert p.refunded_amount==Decimal("500.01")
# exactly 500 no approval
p=mk("600.00"); refund(p,Decimal("500.00"),T0)

# exceeds captured
p=mk(); refund(p,Decimal("60.00"),T0)
